item_short_desc: Rothco's Backup Connectable Back Pack was designed to be attached to Rothco MOLLE Packs with standard 1" side release buckles but this dual compartment pack can be used independently as well. With MOLLE loops on the outside, this tactical pack can easily be customized for military, tactical, or survival purpuses; or snap it onto an existing pack for added space.
